name: Logical Biconditional Framing
description: Transforms the Steiner Tree problem into a logic synthesis scenario. Nodes become boolean propositions, edges become biconditional axioms ($u \leftrightarrow v$), and the Steiner tree requirement becomes a condition that every valid truth assignment must assign the same truth value to all $t$ core propositions. This prevents models from immediately recognizing the graph structure and shortest-path/tree properties.
